## Load packages; start data import

```{r}
library(surveydown)
library(tidyverse)

# Dates - set time to filter below
survey_start <- as_date("2025-12-03")
survey_end <- as_date("2025-12-04")

# Pre-survey
pre_db <- sd_db_connect(gssencmode = "disable", env_file = "student_pre_survey/.env")
pre_dat <- 
  sd_get_data(pre_db) %>%
  mutate(started = as_date(time_start),
         ended = as_date(time_end)) %>% 
  filter(consent == "yes") %>% 
  select(-starts_with("time_"), -current_page) %>% 
  # Exclude some test submissions
  filter(
    session_id != "c31efa757a8b11e565beb9c3558296d6",
    session_id != "d045f825e38f4b7cd18ec44c41c27741",
    session_id != "d6051e073164ec760907dbf52a42d8bb"
  ) %>% 
  filter(started >= survey_start,
         ended <= survey_end) %>% 
  select(-c(session_id, browser, ip_address))

# Do some cleanup
pre_dat_clean <- 
  pre_dat %>% 
  select(-c(likert_skills_etc,likert_interests_etc)) %>% 
  mutate(likert_skills_etc_genetic_data = case_when(
    likert_skills_etc_genetic_data == "one_none" ~ "1",
    likert_skills_etc_genetic_data == "two_oo_ten" ~ "2",
    likert_skills_etc_genetic_data == "three_oo_ten" ~ "3",
    likert_skills_etc_genetic_data == "four_oo_ten" ~ "4",
    likert_skills_etc_genetic_data == "five_oo_ten" ~ "5",
    likert_skills_etc_genetic_data == "six_oo_ten" ~ "6",
    likert_skills_etc_genetic_data == "seven_oo_ten" ~ "7",
    likert_skills_etc_genetic_data == "eight_oo_ten" ~ "8",
    likert_skills_etc_genetic_data == "nine_oo_ten" ~ "9",
    likert_skills_etc_genetic_data == "ten_veryhigh" ~ "10"
  ),
  likert_skills_etc_genetic_data = as.numeric(likert_skills_etc_genetic_data)
  )
```
